non_pass_rules.RESIDUAL: Keep the smallest unresolved product or engineering dependency explicit and do not promote.
non_pass_rules.BLOCKED: Identify the missing dependency or capability and stop.
non_pass_rules.CONFLICT: Preserve competing claims or states; do not use last-write-wins.
non_pass_rules.HUMAN_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Prepare the decision pack and stop before the professional decision.
